title: LOINC list with displayLanguage=zh-CN and includeDesignations
why: Fast: page rows only, but many designations per code.

expectedDifferences.reason: tx.fhir.org has no zh-CN (nor it-IT, el-GR, ru-RU, es-ES, et-EE, pl-PL, tr-TR, fr-BE) LOINC designations, so it falls back to English displays; our LOINC 2.83 import includes the release's linguistic variants, e.g. zh-CN 96,518 designations. tx.fhir.org also adds the server-known Uzbek lang-pack supplement unasked when includeDesignations is set.
